"''Was that Section Four or Section Five?|Two First Order stormtroopers|audio=SectionFourFive-StationToStation.flac|}} '''Section Four''' was a corridor aboard the [[First Order]]'s [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot||refueling station]] ''[[Titan]]''. During a patrol of the [[Space station|station]] in [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|11}} a First Order [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 2 (Titan)|stormtrooper]] asked their [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 1 (Titan)|companion]] if the corridor they just swept was Section Four or [[Section Five]]. The conversation was overheard by [[Resistance]] members [[Neeku Vozo]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]], who were masquerading as [[First Order technician]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Section Four was mentioned in "[[Station to Station]]," the eleventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[December 15]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|Station to Station}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Titan locations]]
